name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 7 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-12-22, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
